# The Kizlo Team - Realtors

> Windermere-based husband and wife real estate team serving West Orlando: Windermere, Winter Garden, Horizon West, and Clermont, Florida. Part of Keller Williams Realty At The Lakes. 130+ homes closed since 2020, $40M+ in sales volume, 4.9 stars across 120+ Google reviews. Services in English and Ukrainian.

- Business name: The Kizlo Team - Realtors

- Languages: English, Ukrainian
- Services: buyer representation, seller representation, home valuations, investor deals, fix and flip guidance
- Track record: 130+ closings since 2020, $40M+ volume, 4.9/5 rating from 120+ Google reviews
